versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-devops 0.0.3

- Expanded and clarified CLI configuration flow, including stricter site type and environment variable handling.
- Added explicit guidance for distinguishing between central site (org ID required, default API base URL) and region site (custom API base URL, no org ID).
- Introduced a mandatory step to pre-configure aliyun-cli for auto plugin installation, avoiding interactive prompts and timeouts.
- Updated fallback channel instructions to better align with site type logic and clarify MCP/mcporter environment requirements.
- Improved token security and error-handling advice throughout the documentation.
- Removed redundant and outdated reference file (`skill-card.md`).

- Enforced a mandatory sequential prerequisite flow: CLI setup and installation are now always attempted before any fallback to MCP or mcporter.
- Added full CLI installation procedure, including new user guidance and OS-specific instructions (see new references/aliyun-cli-install.md).
- Revised token security rules and token variable checks for both CLI and fallback channels.
- Clarified site type/environment detection and command parameterization for both central and region Yunxiao sites.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md and updated multiple references for greater clarity and accuracy.

alibabacloud-devops v0.0.1

- Initial release with automation for Alibaba Cloud Yunxiao DevOps tasks across 8 products.
- Supports pipeline automation, code repository/merge management, work item and sprint tracking, test case and artifact management, and application release workflows.
- Three tool invocation channels supported: Alibaba Cloud CLI, MCP Server, and mcporter CLI.
- Security guidance and mandatory parameter confirmation included for safe automation.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.

alibabacloud-devops 0.0.1-beta.1

- Initial beta release automating Alibaba Cloud Yunxiao DevOps operations across 8 products.
- Provides natural language to Yunxiao API/CLI/MCP actions: pipelines, repositories, merge requests, work items, sprints, test cases, application delivery, and artifact management.
- Includes robust environment, authentication, and token scope checks with strict security guidance.
- Ensures user parameter confirmation before executions.
- Handles errors for common authorization and configuration failures with user guidance.
